/hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra yis// dregs pa can rnams tshar gcod cing*// bstan pa ma lus bsrung ba yi// chos skyong rnams kyis bsrung bar shog /bdag cag lhan cig 'tshogs pa rnams// khro 'khrugs thams cad rab zhi zhing*// zab mo'i gtam ni sna tshogs kyis// sems la phan pa nyid du shog /gang du 'dug pa'i gnas rnams su// 'jigs dang nyam nga bral ba dang*// phyi nang 'tshe ba med pa yi// dgon gnas rnams dang mi 'bral shog /ngo srung brtsol ba mi dgos shing*// ngo bo nyid kyi chos la dkar// phan tshun 'tshe ba med pa yi// skye bo rnams kyis bkur bar shog /bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du// byams pa rgyun chad med pa dang*// rtogs pa gser gri chen po ltar// gnyis med 'gyur ba med par shog /nyon mongs gsum po skyes pa'i tshe// chu la ral gri btab pa bzhin// sems kyi mdud pa bral nas kyang*// 'od gsal ngang la gnas par shog /don med gleng slong zer ba'i tshe// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di rnams kyang*// chos kyi gtam du 'gyur bar shog /sdang ba'i yul rnams mthong ba'i tshe// rang dbang med par byams pa dang*// dang ba'i sems ni skye ba dang*// snying nas mar ni go bar shog /mdzes shing bkrag ldan mthong ba'i tshe// mi gtsang bum par go ba dang*// zhen pa'i mtshan ma rab log nas// chags pa med par gnas par shog /nga rgyal khengs shing dregs pa yi// skye bo rnams dang 'grogs pa na// smad pa'i mtshan ma rab log nas// bsnyen bkur byed par gnas gyur cig /shes pa'i tshogs ni ma lus pas// ltem rkyang bral ba'i chos sku la// mos gus rgya chen byed pa dang*// gnyen po brtan par gnas par shog /sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu des// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa ru// sems can rnams la smin 'gyur shog// / ༄༅// seng ge'i 'grel chung bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so/

oṃ swa sti// dge legs kyis rab tu rgyal bar gyur cig /rang byung 'od gsal byang chub sems kyi sku// dpal chen bdud 'joms ye shes mkhyen par ldan// chos rgyal bla med rnam grol 'khor los bsgyur// lha mi'i ston pa 'bri gung bzhugs la 'dud// zhing khams mi mjed pad+mo'i tshal dbus 'dir// 'dul mdzad ston pa thugs rje'i 'od phreng can// shākya'i rgyal po khri gdugs nyi ma shar// gzi brjid bde skyid dpal des phyogs bcur khyab// 'dir ltar nged bcag snyigs ma'i sems can thams cad kyis ston pa dang*/ skyabs dang 'dren pa gcig pur gyur pa/ bde bar gshegs pa dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa rnams la/ thabs mkhas shing thugs rje khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas lus can thams cad thar pa'i gzhal yas khang du kha lo bsgyur ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji snyed par mgon po rin po che rnam pa gsum mi zad pa'i gter chen po la mnga' mdzad pa// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes phyogs bcur grags pa de 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon ste/ de yang sngon thog ma'i tshe/ yun ring po nas thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa yongs su rdzogs par ni gyur/ grangs med pa'i bskal par bya dka' ba'i mdzad pa 'bras bu dang bcas rlabs po che'i khur rnam pa shin tu mthar phyin pas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba/ yongs su skyob pa med pa rnams la/ dam pa'i chos bstan pa'i phyag rkyang bas ni rab tu ston/ nyon mongs pa'i mes rab tu brdungs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chu rgyun gyis shin tu bsil ba ni bgyis/

so so'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing yongs su smin la rnam par grol nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub rin chen gyi gling dam pa der 'god par mdzad pa'i/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis rab tu sngags zhing*/ khyad par du bkur la/ legs par stod cing gsung dbyangs phyogs bcu'i zhing du sgrog par 'gyur ba lags na/ lha dang mi'i 'jig rten gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de la bdag cag bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje dang ldan pa de'i gdul rgyar gyur cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'khod pa'i bskal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ 'dul mdzad ston pa de nyid kyi rigs mi 'chol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i khungs gang lags pa khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan gyis dring la mi 'jog par sku drin gzhal du med pa dran pa'i sgo nas byas pa bzo shing*/ mdzad pa dang gsung gi rjes su bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang*/ skyes bu dam pa mkhas par gyur pa rnams kyi rab tu mngags shing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gzengs bstod par 'gyur ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ thos nas kyang dga' ba dang dad pa skyes pa tsam gyis rang gzhan gyi don chen po 'thob bo// zhes bsod nams kyi yon bshad par gyur pa dang*/ gnas 'di ni zang zing gis ma spags shing 'phags pa'i gtam/ shākya'i sras dge sbyong bsod nams pa bdag la'ang 'os shing*/ thub pa'i bstan pa gsal bar 'gyur ba'i slad du/ mdzad pa'i tshul dang*/ rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i yi ge 'go smos par bya ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ thog mar byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing brtse ba chen pos zhing 'di bzung ba'i mdzad pa dang gcig bar du dka' ba spyod pa rlabs po ches thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab 'di yang dag par bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ mthar 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba'i mdzad pa dang gsum mo// thog mar byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa'i mdzad pa la don gnyis te/

kun nas yongs su snang ba'i thugs bskyed pa dang gcig bla mar gyur pa'i mchog gis thugs bskyed pa dang gnyis so// yongs su snang ba la'ang gnyis/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las ji ltar snang ba dang*/ mdo sde'i sde snod las ji ltar snang ba rnam pa gnyis so// bla mar gyur pa mchog la don lnga te/ dus gang gi tshe thugs bskyed pa dang gcig sku skye ba ji ltar bzhes pa gnyis/ ston pa gang gi drung dang gsum/ tshul ji ltar bskyed pa dang bzhi/ thugs bskyed pas khyad par du ji ltar 'phags pa dang rnam pa lnga'o// bar du thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i mdzad pa la don bdun te/ ltos med mi zad sbyin pas bsgrubs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig gtsang ma'i tshangs spyod tshul khrims kyis bsgrubs pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ zhi dul des pa bzod pas bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ ma zhum mi skyo brtson 'grus kyis bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig bsam gtan gyis bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang lnga/ rnam 'byed don rtogs shes rab kyis bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang drug de dag mthar son pa'i bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa bdun no// mthar 'bras bu phun tshogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa la don rnam pa gsum ste/ gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbang phyug dang 'byor pa zil gyis mnan pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa dang gcig gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams dka' thub dang brtul zhugs zil gyis mnan pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang gnyis/ gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams kyis sdig pa can gyis dpung zil gyis mnon pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa dang rnam pa gsum mo// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa dang po la lnga ste/ dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/

sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ gzhon nu rol rtsed gyi mdzad pa dang bzhi/ btsun mo'i 'khor bsten pa'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa lnga'o// dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa la don gnyis ste/ gnas skabs de nyid na bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig mtha' thug thugs kyi dgongs pa'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa gnyis so// thugs kyis dgongs pa'i mdzad pa la'ang don gnyis te/ dgongs pa'i rgyu mtshan bskul ba'i dam bcas pa'i spyi don dang gcig rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa'i mdzad pa bye brag gi don dang rnam pa gnyis so// mdzad pa bye brag gi don la gsum/ mchog dang mchog ma yin pa'i khyad par bstan pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling du rig byed bzhag pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig sus kyang rgol bar mi nus shing legs par spyad pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan pa'i mdzad dang gnyis/ lha rnams la legs par gdams shing rgyal tshab dbang bskur ba'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa gsum mo// lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa la lnga ste/ khyad par can gyis snga ltas bstan pa dang gcig zhum 'bring ba'i rnam 'phrul dang gnyis/ sku gzugs kyis rnam pa ji lta bu dang gsum/ lhums na ji ltar zhugs pa dang bzhi/ 'phrin las ji lta bu mdzad pa dang lnga'o// ji ltar zhugs pa'i tshul la ya mtshan gyi mdzad pa lnga dang ldan te/ sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde blag tu zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang gcig rnam par dag cing gtsang bar zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang gnyis/ srung ma dang bcas te bar chad med par zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang gsum/ sku yongs su rdzogs te ma tshang bar med par zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang bzhi/ mngon gsum du mthong zhing sgrib pa med par zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang rnam pa lnga'o// phrin las kyi mdzad pa sgo rnam pa bzhi dang ldan te/ mun tshogs 'joms pa sgron me'i sgo dang gcig chos kyi 'khor lo rnam grol gyi sgo dang gnyis/ zug rngu sel ba sman gyi sgo dang gsum/

thabs mkhas phan 'dogs gnyen bshes kyis sgo dang bzhi'o// 'dren pa sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa la don gsum te/ bkra shis 'byor ldan gyi dus gang lags pa dang gcig sa phyogs yid 'ong gi gnas gang lags pa dang gnyis/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bltams tshul gang lags pa dang gsum mo/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bltams tshul la lnga ste/ lha mi'i 'jig rten dpang por gyur cing gnod pa dang rtsod pa dang bral nas khyad par du 'phags pa dang gcig mi shig pa rdo rje'i sku mnyes pas seng ge'i rtsal bstan cing seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang gnyis/ rnam par rol pa'i cho 'phrul gyis ya mtshan gyi bkod pa bstan pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang gsum/ skye dgu'i bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub ste don dang ldan pa'i mtshan rtsol ba khyad par du 'phags pa dang bzhi/ gzhung smra ba'i mkhyen pa dang mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i gzigs pas mi 'gyur ba'i lung bstan pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang lnga'o// gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi sgra gsal bar byed pa yi ge'i rig byed bstan pa'i rol rtsed dang gcig tshad grangs kyi dbye ba bstan la 'beb par byed pa rtsis kyi rig byed bstan pa'i rol rtsed dang gnyis/ sku'i mthu stobs sgyu rtsal phun gsum tshogs pa bstan pa'i rol rtsed dang rnam pa gsum mo// sgyu rtsal bstan pa la don gsum ste/ zhabs mthe bong gis mthu rtsal bstan pa dang gcig phyag sor mo'i mthu rtsal bstan pa dang gnyis/ 'phong la sogs pa'i mthu rtsal bstan pa dang gsum mo// btsun mo'i 'khor bstan pa'i mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ khyad par can gyi dgos byed gang lags pa dang gcig khab tu bzhes tshul gang lags pa dang gnyis/ khab na bzhugs pa'i tshul gang lags pa dang gsum mo// dgos khyad la rnam pa gnyis te/ gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po bsgrub pa dang*/

sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa'o// bzhugs pa'i tshul la che ba'i yon tan rnam pa bzhi dang ldan ste/ pho brang dam pa gnas kyi che ba'i yon tan dang gcig phun sum tshogs pa longs spyod kyi che ba'i yon tan dang gnyis/ 'khor los bsgyur ba rgyal srid kyi che ba'i yon tan dang gsum/ zhi ba chags bral lha chos kyi che ba'i yon tan dang bzhi'o// de ltar btsun mo'i 'khor bstan pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa dang gnyis/ sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang bzhi/ dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang lngas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa dang po bstan pa'o// ༈ //ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sku rab tu gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum mo// rab tu bshegs pa'i mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ 'phags pa'i tshogs dang lha'i tshogs kyis bskul ba'i don dang gcig thugs dgongs lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo ba med pa'i mthu rtsal bstan pa'i don dang gnyis/ dka' thub kyi rtsal du rang byung gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i don dang gsum/ dang po bskul ba la gsum ste/ rol mo sil snyan gyis sgras bskul ba dang gcig mi rtag pa'i snang bas bskul ba dang gnyis/ rnam grol gyi gnas tshangs par spyod pa'i bskul ba dang gsum mo// lhag bsam gyi mthu rtsal bstan pa la gnyis/ sa steng skye bo 'dod ldan gyi dpung tshogs mgo rmongs par bgyis pa dang gcig gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi dpung tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring bgyis pa dang gnyis so// bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i don la gnyis ste/ dge slong gi yo byad ci ltar bzhes pa dang gcig dge slong gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa dang gnyis so// dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa la don nyer gnyis/

dka' thub can gyi man ngag mngon du mdzad pa dang gcig dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul ji lta bu bstan pa dang gnyis/ dka' ba spyad pa'i dgongs pa gang yin pa dang gsum mo// dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul la lnga ste/ gnas dang gcig 'tsho ba dang gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ spyod lam dang bzhi/ yun ji srid pa dang lnga'o// byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa la don lnga ste/ ngal zhing dub pa sbyor ba'i mtha' spang ba'i mdzad pa dang gcig byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i shul ji ltar brgyan pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ gang yang 'jig rten gyis mun pa 'thibs po'i gnas snang bar byed pa dang gsum/ chos kyi bde ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i gdan bzhes pa'i mdzad pa dang bzhi/ rdo rje'i gdan de la ji ltar bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang lnga'o// de ltar byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ sku rab tu gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum gyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gnyis pa bstan pa'o// ༈ //ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa gsum pa la/ don bla na med pa rnam pa gsum ste/ bdud kyi sde 'joms pa'i mdzad pa bla na med pa dang gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bla na med pa dang gnyis/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i mdzad pa bla na med pa dang gsum/ bdud sde bcom pa'i mdzad pa la gsum/ bdud kyis go bar mdzad pa dang gcig bdud sde ji ltar lhags pa dang gnyis/ 'joms par mdzad pa nyid dang gsum mo// 'joms par mdzad pa nyid la/ mthar phyin pa'i mdzad pa lnga ste/ sku'i gzi brjid mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang gcig gsung gi sgra dbyangs mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang gnyis/ thugs kyi dgongs pa mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang gsum/ yon tan gyi bkod pa mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang bzhi/ 'phrin las kyi rol pa mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang lnga'o// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa la gsum ste/

thugs gang la mnyam par bzhag cing ji ltar thugs su chud pas sangs rgyas pa dang gcig dus kyi rgyal po gang gi tshe sangs rgyas pa dang gnyis/ sangs rgyas nas rnam par 'phrul pa ji lta bu bstan pa dang gsum mo// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i don dang gcig chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i don dang gnyis/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i don dang gsum mo// jiltar bskor ba'i don la phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga ste/ bla na med pa'i ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang gcig don chen 'grub pa dus kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang gnyis/ mchog gi bstan pa gnas kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang gsum/ skal ldan gdul bya 'khor gyi phun sum tshogs pa dang bzhi/ thog mthar dge ba chos kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang lnga'o// chos kyi 'khor lor cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i don la bzhi ste/ yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer gnyan yod du bstan pa dang gcig cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer gsal ldan du bstan pa dang gnyis/ yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu bstan pa dang gsum/ yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer yangs pa can du bstan pa la sogs pa dang rnam pa bzhi'o// de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa dang gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ bdud sde bcom pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum gyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa gsum pa bstan pa'o// ༈ //dgung lo'i skabs kyang smos par bya ste/ yab rgyal po'i pho brang du thub pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bar du bzhugs so// de nas dgung lo drug gi bar btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs so// gang yang thub pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes pa'i tshe rab tu gshegs so// de nas dgung lo drug gi bar du dka' thub kyi 'tshal du bzhugs te/

gang yang thub pa dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po brnyes so// de nas dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun gyi bar du chos kyi 'khor lo cho 'phrul dang bcas pa bskor zhing bstan pa mdzad do// gang yang thub pa dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'tsho zhing bzhes so// de ltar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rnam pa gsum gyis/ mthar 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan to// de'i gong du bya dka' ba'i spyod pas thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab 'di yang dag par bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa ston to// de'i gong du byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing brtse ba chen pos zhing 'di bzung ba'i mdzad pa bstan to// de ltar rnam pa gsum gyis/ nged kyis ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i mdzad pa'i rim pa dag 'go smos pa'i tshig gis brjod pa yin la/ de'i gong du brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa bdun dang bcas ste bstan pa lags so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul de dag zhib mo dang*/ rgyas par ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa'i drin thob cing*/ ston pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho nyid kyis rjes su 'brangs nas/ yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis mig dang*/ phyin phyi ma log pa'i blo gros kyis rtogs shing khong du chud par byas te/ ji srid sems can gyi khams dang*/ chos kyi dbyings dang*/ de bzhin nyid mnyam zhing*/ skyon thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ yon tan mthar phyin pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad par gtsang ba dang dam pa'i bdag dang*/ bde ba dang*/ rtag pa'i sku mya ngan las mi 'da' ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo nub par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyal sras dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgyun mi 'chad cing*/
